basic_info.description: Welcome to The Marlow. Built in 2014, The Marlow is situated at the juncture of three Prime neighborhoods, Nob Hill, Russian Hill, and Pacific Heights. Residence 304 is a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condominium beaming with sunlight. This bright and airy unit checks all the boxes including a in-unit washer and dryer, deeded 1 car parking, generous closets, and central air and heating. The well-appointed open floor plan includes a chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, wide-plank wood floors, and floor-to-ceiling windows. Marlow offers 98 Modern, Luxurious condominium residences in the heart of restaurants, nightlife, shopping, and culture. Residents enjoy amenities including a lobby attendant, landscaped communal courtyard, bocce ball court, BBQ area, and outdoor fire pit/lounge area, as well as close proximity to Muni lines.
